title: Engineering lesson and improvement preparation
description: Governance prepares participant-supplied lesson, context, improvement and observed-effect content for guided engineering work while preserving separate learning, adoption, assurance and custody authority.

operations.name: characterize_supported_lesson
operations.purpose: Prepare supported reuse or a bounded local-correction disposition.
inputs: Identifiable finding, original context/version and attributable observations.
Supplied causal interpretation, alternatives/contradictions, reuse rationale, applicability/exclusions and selected operation/confirmation context.
outputs: Exact characterized lesson candidate, explicit hypothesis/support limits or local-correction disposition; actual retention remains separate.
behavior: Apply MOD-009 improvement.md under FUNC-035/AR-082; facts and causal inferences remain distinct.
Respect learning.md confirmation and no-clobber/topic/route custody for selected Learn operations; preparation has no topic or route effect.

failure_behavior.condition: Required identity, context, source support or governing decision is missing, contradictory or changed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve available attributable content and affected unresolved scope; do not invent a lesson, adopted change, favorable claim or current applicability.

failure_behavior.condition: Selected retention or owner effects are unavailable, incomplete or uncertain.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return prepared-versus-observed effects and the responsible reconciliation; no implicit save, owner invocation or blind retry.

operations.name: select_applicable_lessons
operations.purpose: Explain relevant lessons and current improvement disposition for a declared planned activity.
inputs: Planned activity and material context, selected available lesson scope and exact inspected content/availability.
Supplied authoritative improvement decisions, affected versions and their known current applicability.
outputs: Lessons with compared applicability/exclusions, examined population and acquisition limits, current supported disposition or named missing context.
behavior: Apply FUNC-036/AR-083; distinguish known exclusions, insufficient context, unavailable sources and no match in a completely inspected scope.
No implicit external search, adoption, policy override or permission; changed source/context requires a new basis or explicit unresolved result.

operations.name: prepare_accountable_improvement
operations.purpose: Prepare an assessable proposal and associate separately supplied controlled dispositions.
inputs: Supported lesson/mechanism/basis, applicability, exact affected subjects and accountable owner.
Intended behavior and independently specified success/adverse-effect criteria; governing decision and actual adopted outcome when supplied.
outputs: Attributable proposal or missing readiness context, with proposed/revised/rejected/adopted scope distinctly tied to its governing basis.
behavior: Apply FUNC-037/AR-084; missing owner, subject, support or criterion prevents a ready-for-adoption claim.
MOD-012 hands content to existing IF-009/016 and the authorized destination owner; a route, approval of direction or preparation cannot fabricate adopted artifacts or effectiveness.

operations.name: compare_observed_improvement_effects
operations.purpose: Compare actual opportunity-bound effects and identify current reassessment needs.
inputs: Adopted version and exact prepared criteria, applicability, observer/provenance and triggering observations or nonreproducibility.
Available later activity context/order and comparability reasoning; actual recurrence, intended behavior, adverse effects, missing/contrary observations and material changes.
outputs: Context-bounded comparison with reproduction and later opportunity distinct, explicit unassessed scope or reassessment need, and original observations preserved.
behavior: Apply FUNC-038/AR-085; no comparable activity and missing observations at an actual opportunity are different gaps.
Require actual supported observations for any effectiveness conclusion; preserve mixed results, known earlier comparable failures and limitations of the selected population.
MOD-012 passes supplied methods/observations or assessor judgments through IF-014/010; IF-017 does not create generic assurance approval or renew old observations.

consistency_rules: MOD-017 owns the external contract; MOD-009 retains FUNC-035–038, AR-082–085 and domain context. MOD-012 owns invocation and exact content handoff.
Observations, causal hypotheses, reusable lessons, proposals, adoption, route settlement and observed effectiveness remain distinct.
MOD-006 IF-009/016 retains authority/transition meaning; MOD-007 IF-010/014 retains generic assurance. Neither is replaced by lesson preparation.
Existing Learn confirmation and no-clobber/idempotent custody apply to selected operations; result-only route updates cannot invoke owners or mutate unrelated state.
Selected artifact or IF-004/003 retention confirms actual saved effects separately. No automatic discovery, polling, task execution or storage call is supplied.
compatibility_rules: Logical participant-assisted contract only; no new public command, wire vocabulary, REM entity, native record type or mandatory lesson schema.
Existing Learn session/topic/route contracts and historical meanings remain intact; no implicit import or workflow adoption.
Current v2/v4 recording uses existing tasks and exact supporting attachments when required; standalone operation retains its chosen writer and project authority.
Unperformed or unsupported assessment remains explicit. Existing installed skills and tool runtimes are not qualified by this target Design.

sources.basis: Refine supported lesson characterization, bounded contextual use, accountable proposals and opportunity-based effect assessment through MOD-009 and parent IF-017. Preserve existing Learn confirmation/custody/route boundaries and separate controlled adoption, assurance and retention. Proposed Design only.
